value.rationale: This is a complete natural low-dimensional fixed-space classification of all nonidentity symmetries of the first 2-dimensional even-block partition complex. Five involutions fix wedges of sixteen circles despite the ambient two-dimensional sphere-wedge homology. It identifies a genuine geometric fixed-homotopy distinction invisible to Lefschetz ranks and supplies executable exhaustive certificates, not an arbitrary isolated numeric slice.
